    import pandas as pd
    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Top_Three_Identity_Theft_Reports_by_Year.csv"
    # File has a title row and blank lines; real header appears on the second non-empty row.
    df = pd.read_csv(path, header=None)

    # Find the header row containing the expected fields
    header_idx = None
    for i in range(min(len(df), 50)):

    data['year'] = data['year'].astype(str).str.strip()
    data['reports'] = data['reports'].astype(str).str.strip()

    return data.reset_index(drop=True)

    import pandas as pd
    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Top_Three_Identity_Theft_Reports_by_Year.csv"

    raw = pd.read_csv(path, header=None, dtype=str, keep_default_na=False)

    # Locate the header row by finding 'Theft Type' and 'Year' in the first two columns
    header_idx = None

    data["year"] = data["year"].astype(str).str.strip()
    data["reports"] = data["reports"].astype(str).str.strip()

    # Drop empty and footer rows
    data = data[(data["theftType"] != "") & (data["year"] != "")]
    data = data[~data["theftType"].str.lower().str.startswith("source")]

    # Parse numeric
    data["year"] = pd.to_numeric(data["year"], errors="coerce")
    data["reports"] = pd.to_numeric(data["reports"].str.replace(",", "", regex=False), errors="coerce")
    data = data.dropna(subset=["theftType", "year", "reports"])

def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Top_Three_Identity_Theft_Reports_by_Year.csv"
    raw = pd.read_csv(path, header=None, dtype=str, keep_default_na=False)

    # Find the header row that contains the 3 expected column labels.
    header_mask = (
        raw[0].str.strip().eq("Theft Type")
        & raw[1].str.strip().eq("Year")
        & raw[2].str.strip().str.contains("# of Reports", regex=False)
    )
    if not header_mask.any():
        # Fallback: return raw for debugging
        return raw.head(30)

    header_idx = int(raw.index[header_mask][0])
    df = raw.iloc[header_idx + 1 :, 0:3].copy()
    df.columns = ["year", "theftType", "reports"]

    # Clean
    for c in df.columns:
        df[c] = df[c].astype(str).str.strip()
    df = df[(df["year"] != "") & (df["theftType"] != "") & (df["reports"] != "")]

    # Keep only data rows where year looks numeric
    df = df[df["year"].str.fullmatch(r"\d{4}")].copy()

    df["year"] = pd.to_numeric(df["year"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")
    df["reports"] = pd.to_numeric(df["reports"].str.replace(",", "", regex=False), errors="coerce")

    df = df.dropna(subset=["year", "theftType", "reports"]).copy()
    df["year"] = df["year"].astype(int)
    df["reports"] = df["reports"].astype(int)

    return df.sort_values(["theftType", "year"]).reset_index(drop=True)
